summary.mutations: NONE: no checkout, reset, clean, branch deletion or patch application
summary.limits: A merged PR head or matching patch is evidence for review, never permission to remove a branch or WIP. Squash ancestry alone is insufficient. Active workers may modify their files after this snapshot.
summary.wip_triage_method: Whole-file LF-normalized comparison against the pinned main blob and merged PR heads. No claim about patch presence or missing implementation from local apply checks.
